summary: Build scorecards, define KPIs, and create executive-ready reporting with practical tools. Enrol in advanced 5-day training.
lede: Balanced Scorecard and KPI Design helps you connect strategic objectives with meaningful measures, targets, and initiatives. You will learn to build strategy maps, define leading and lagging indicators, develop KPI trees, and align performance measures with outcomes rather than activity. The course gives you practical experience creating KPI catalogues, setting thresholds, interpreting dashboards, and preparing performance review packs for management decisions. You will also explore scorecard governance, data-quality checks, and automation-supported KPI refresh routines that help keep reporting clear, credible, and useful over time.
audienceIntro: This advanced Balanced Scorecard and KPI Design course is intended for professionals who already contribute to strategy execution, performance reporting, or measurement governance and now need stronger design capability.
prerequisites: Participants should already have working familiarity with organizational performance reporting, basic KPI terminology, and spreadsheet-based analysis. Prior exposure to strategy maps, dashboards, or management reporting is helpful, and confidence using Excel or a business intelligence platform will support the practical exercises. No programming is required, but you should come prepared to review sample scorecards, compare metric definitions, and work with performance data structures.
